Five months ago, in July, I bought a sofa and mattress from Leena Decor.
When the sofa and mattress were delivered, just one week later, the sofa started sagging, and its fabric started loosening.

After one week, when we complained, they sent a person who makes sofas.
He came and said that there's no problem, that it's normal for a sofa to be soft, and if we didn't want it that soft, they would need to add ply so that it wouldn’t sag.

The next day, we called again, and another person came. He said the same thing: wait for a month, and if it sags again, they would fix it. I also told him that bed bugs had started appearing.

After a month, the sofa sagged even more, and the fabric became completely loose with wrinkles all over it.

When I called to complain, they said they would come in a week to check the issue because the festival season was going on.

When they took the sofa, we went to their shop, and the owner was rude and started arguing. Then, they made the condition of the sofa worse and added ply underneath.

Since the sofa arrived, bed bugs have come with it. I raised this issue too, but they didn’t respond.

If you use poor-quality material, everyone is bound to get bed bugs.

These people have scammed so many customers. Who knows how many people’s money they've taken like this.

They take customers' money and provide terrible quality products.

Within one week, bed bugs appeared, which means the sofa was made from second-hand, cheap materials.

They are so cheap that they’ve only built a big showroom but are looting multiple customers.

I will only say this: if anyone wants to get trapped, then buy from Leena Decor. And if anyone wants bed bugs in their house, go ahead and buy from them

Worst service ..Giving one star as I dont have option of giving 0 star. If only I had read the reviews

I visited the shop to get my old sofa repaired. I found their rates to be higher but thought that they will do a good job so decided to go ahead. They committed me 4th June on a higher side. I was okay as we had a family function on 5th June and would be obviously needing sofa for people to sit.
I started following up with them from 2nd june . I use to get the same answer that you will get it by tomorrow. They even didn't send it on the 5th and everytime that I called I was committed the next day . Finally they send it across on the 7th June .

Inspite of such pathetic service wherein I couldn't get my sofa when I needed it the most unfortunately I went back there again as the sales guy convinced me that it was one of the problem which generally never happens . So I booked new cupboard,  bed and one sofa cum bed giving some advance.

As I was waiting for my order to come , I noticed that the sofa which had just got repaired 4 days back started getting back to the same condition as it was before giving for repairs. I called up and was promised  that he will send the sofa technician at my place to check the next day. Next entire day went by and no one came. I called him back and he told me that he will come next day. Again the entire day passed by and no one came.  For me I was losing my patience as everytime he told me someone is coming I use to wait for him.  Finally after calling him again this technician Finally came. On examine the sofa , he told me that he will come next day and open the sofa at my place and fill in and repair it. Next day I schedule myself accordingly and neither he came nor anyone called me to inform.

Finally by this time I realised that these people are not professionals and for me to take more furniture from them would be disastrous.

Next day I send them a msg that I don't want to buy any more furniture from them seeing their horrible product quality and after sales service.  On getting that msg and fearing that I will cancel the future orders, he immediately send the person to pick up the sofa.

But by this time I had made up my mind not to fall in this trap.  Moreover I read their reviews and it was equally pathetic. I send his person away and informed him that I will repair the sofa somewhere else.

My Advance is gone but I would be happy even if few of customers change their plans to buy their products after reading my review....
